verdict.rationale: The Agent Skills spec requires a `description` field in every SKILL.md that should describe both what the skill does and when to use it. The official template and a spec example follow this, frontmatter can control whether the user or Claude invokes a skill, and skill-creator can tune descriptions for triggering accuracy. However, hands-on reports show activation does not reliably follow the documented description: skills often fail to trigger on expected keywords, and a cited Vercel eval found a skill never invoked in 56% of cases. So the description does not let a developer reliably predict agent behavior. Missing for 10: deterministic or predictable activation matching the documented triggers, enforcement (beyond 'should') that every skill states when it activates, and independent corroboration that descriptions accurately predict behavior.
